propositions: Ticket descriptions exceeding 8,000 characters must block plan review before any LLM call and return deterministic BLOCK with coverage.llm_ran=false.
Ticket descriptions exceeding 8,000 characters must block completion verification before runner calls and return validated deterministic FAIL with zero runner invocations.
The 8,000-character maximum must be configurable through typed [verify] configuration with a default value and must enforce strict greater-than boundary (8,000 allowed, 8,001 blocked).
In light-bug-review plan-review flow, P4 description-size blocks must be retained as blocking while other DET blocks are downgraded to advisory.
AC-count and file-impact P4 signals must remain advisory when description is within the maximum, and P4 must emit at most one oversize finding.
